lines.en: I do not touch ground; I walk on ki.
Half a block off the ground will do.

lines.zh: 王子走路，也用不着沾土。
lines.en: A prince need not soil his boots.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，气在脚底。
lines.en: I advance step by step, ki under my soles.

lines.zh: 身后的空气被我压出一道光。
lines.en: The air behind me smears with light.
I count your openings under my breath.
This street is too narrow for practice.

lines.zh: 我掠过地面，留下一道焦痕。
lines.en: I skim the ground and leave a scorch.
I do not run. I do not need to.

lines.zh: 我在半空停了一下，再走。
lines.en: I pause in the air, then go on.

lines.zh: 气在身后拖着，像条尾巴。
lines.en: My ki trails behind me like a tail.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的脚步，从不放轻。
lines.en: A Saiyan does not soften his step.
Draw the ki in and save it.
I am calculating your power level.
This wind cannot move me.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看天，什么也没有。
lines.en: I look at the sky and find nothing.

lines.zh: 手指一弹，空气裂了一下。
lines.en: One flick and the air cracks.

lines.zh: 我的头发烧着一层紫光。
lines.en: Violet light burns along my hair.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得的理由。
lines.en: I wait for a reason worth the effort.

lines.zh: 这具身体的伤，早就习惯了。
lines.en: This body is used to wounds.
I close my eyes once, then open them.

lines.zh: 没有对手，连站着都无趣。
lines.en: Without a rival, even standing is dull.

lines.zh: 我压着这口气，别让它散。
lines.en: I hold this ki in before it bleeds away.
The birds have all fled.

lines.zh: 我在想，谁会先沉不住气。
lines.en: I wonder who will break first.
You? Standing before me?

lines.zh: 报上名字，我不打无名之辈。
lines.en: Name yourself. I do not fight the nameless.
Your ki is pitifully weak.

lines.zh: 我把你从上到下扫了一眼。
lines.en: I look you over, head to boots.
Even your fist is wrong.
Do not tremble. I have not started.
The prince is watching. Look up.
If you would challenge me, say so plainly.

lines.zh: 你那点自信，撑不过三招。
lines.en: That confidence will last three moves.
I smile. It is not a kind smile.

lines.zh: 我让你先动，免得说我欺负人。
lines.en: You move first, so no one calls me a bully.
Stand straight. Do not make me look down on you.
I smell fear on you.

lines.zh: 就算你跪下，我也不会停。
lines.en: Kneeling will not make me stop.

lines.zh: 我抬手，只是想看看你退不退。
lines.en: I raise a hand just to see if you flinch.

lines.zh: 你这副样子，像来送死的。
lines.en: You look like you came to die.
Finished? Then begin.
Tch. You actually landed one.
This is not even a warm-up.
My ki scattered for an instant.
Blood at my lip. I wipe it away.
Interesting. You are stronger than you look.
I am putting that on your tab.
My body is already mending.

lines.zh: 区区一击，也配让我认真？
lines.en: One hit like that, and you expect me to try?
Food? I do not move for that.

lines.zh: 这点东西，收买不了赛亚王子。
lines.en: That will not buy a Saiyan prince.

lines.zh: 你拿吃的当筹码，很失礼。
lines.en: Offering food as a chip is insulting.

lines.zh: 我确实饿了，但不代表我软。
lines.en: I am hungry, not weak.
Set it down. Then back away.

lines.zh: 我一口吞了，算给你面子。
lines.en: I swallow it whole, as a courtesy.

lines.zh: 吃完再说，别以为我欠你。
lines.en: After eating, understand I owe you nothing.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的胃口，你养不起。
lines.en: No one can feed a Saiyan's appetite.

lines.zh: 这东西的热量，够我出一拳。
lines.en: That much fuel is worth one punch.
I will not thank you, but I will remember.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我连衣角都没动。
lines.en: You struck me and my robe did not shift.
One block of my hand and you recoil.

lines.zh: 别碰我，王子的礼服很贵。
lines.en: Do not touch me. The prince's garb is costly.

lines.zh: 你这点力气，撞得开山吗？
lines.en: With that strength, can you split a mountain?
This close, you have some nerve.

lines.zh: 你被我的气推开了一段。
lines.en: My aura shoved you back a stretch.
Bump me and walk off? Again.
This muscle is not decoration.

lines.zh: 退三步，别让我再说一遍。
lines.en: Three steps back. I will not repeat it.
This does not need an audience.
Saiyan blood must not end.
I turn my back to you. Do not read into it.

lines.zh: 我们之间，只剩这点默契。
lines.en: Only this much understanding remains between us.
When she stands there, I go quiet.

lines.zh: 这世上，能让我低头的没几个。
lines.en: Few in this world can make me lower my head.
I set my hand on her shoulder.
We are like two old soldiers.

lines.zh: 骄傲归骄傲，人也需要人。
lines.en: Pride is pride. People still need people.
Before dawn, I will leave again.

lines.zh: 地上那东西，值得我弯腰？
lines.en: Is that worth bending down for?
I draw it up with ki.
What is this? Let me see.
I hold it, and it crumbles.
Too brittle. Not interesting.
I drop it. No use.
An unclaimed senzu? Mine.
I roll it between my fingers and catch its smell.
I flick it up with my foot and catch it.
Whoever dropped it can come and collect.

lines.zh: 气弹上膛，你的名字在准星里。
lines.en: Ki blasts charged, your name sits in my sights.
Your ki is not going anywhere.
Can you take this punch?
Do not look. I am right here.
You have brought this to me.

lines.zh: 我压着的气，一下全开了。
lines.en: The ki I held floods open.

lines.zh: 地面开始裂，是我站的地方。
lines.en: The ground splits where I stand.

lines.zh: 额头这道印记，是我自愿刻的。
lines.en: This mark on my brow, I carved it myself.
When I raise my hand, you should run.
This time I hold nothing back.

lines.zh: 我要看看你还能站多久。
lines.en: Let us see how long you stand.
From this moment, you are the target.
Here I come. Do not blink.

lines.zh: 残影一闪，我已经在你背后。
lines.en: Afterimages flicker; I am already behind you.
I circle you. No hurry.
I have read every move you have.
Faster. You move like a snail.
I am finding where your limit sits.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子，不喜欢等。
lines.en: The prince of Saiyans does not like to wait.

lines.zh: 我故意留了个破绽，你会上当。
lines.en: I left an opening on purpose. You will take it.
Ki spins in my palm.
Your guard is collapsing.

lines.zh: 你打不中我，一次也没有。
lines.en: You have not landed one hit.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是让你以为有机会。
lines.en: I give half a step to make you think you have a chance.
A blast forms between my fingers.
I wait until your strength runs out.
When this circle closes, it ends.
How much longer do you think you last?
My ki rises. Yours falls.

lines.zh: 最后再说一次，认输不丢人。
lines.en: One last time: yielding is no disgrace.

lines.zh: 一拳下去，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: One punch and the ground caves in.
Elbow, knee, in sequence.
I strike at your balance.

lines.zh: 残影还在原地，人已经绕后。
lines.en: The afterimage stays while I am already behind.
This kick sends you through a wall.
A decent block. Once.
I wrap my fist in ki and strike.
Blasts chase you from my palm.

lines.zh: 连击之后，我补一记重手。
lines.en: After the flurry, I add one heavy blow.
This punch is a prince's courtesy.

lines.zh: 我越打越快，你越来越慢。
lines.en: I speed up. You slow down.

lines.zh: 这一下，是为了刚才那句话。
lines.en: That was for what you said earlier.
I drive you into the dirt with one boot.
Get up. I am not finished.
Big Bang Attack. Brace yourself.
Final Flash. Do not dodge.
Ki tears through this sky.

lines.zh: 魔人的印记在我额头上发烫。
lines.en: The Majin mark burns on my forehead.

lines.zh: 这个世界的重力，太轻了。
lines.en: This world's gravity is too light.
Who summoned me here?

lines.zh: 地上这些小家伙，不值一提。
lines.en: These little things on the ground are nothing.
I land and carve a crater.
The Saiyan prince has arrived. Look up.
The ki here is thin.

lines.zh: 我先看看这里有什么可打的。
lines.en: Let me see what there is to fight.
There is a smell of gunpowder. Acceptable.
The power in this body remains.

lines.zh: 这地方没有对手，很无聊。
lines.en: No rivals here. Dull.
I straighten my gloves and stand tall.
There is still a charge in my hair.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里归我看着。
lines.en: From today, I keep an eye on this place.
I open my eyes and the light scatters.
Another meaningless battle.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我看看这世界的强度。
lines.en: Come. Show me what this world can do.
Flame bites my skin. I do not step back.

lines.zh: 从这个高度摔下去，骨头都响。
lines.en: At this height, my bones ring on impact.
Water in my windpipe. Unpleasant.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀起来又放下。
lines.en: The blast lifts me and drops me.

lines.zh: 什么东西打穿了我的肩。
lines.en: Something pierced my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这股怪力，压得我抬不起手。
lines.en: This strange force pins my arms.

lines.zh: 饿到这个地步，气都提不上来。
lines.en: Starved this far, I cannot raise my ki.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我笑了一声。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I laugh once.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我在往下跌。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; I am falling.
